qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: SGS provides testing and certification switching-cost advantages, and Pernod Ricard/adidas possess consumer brand intangibles. However, major consolidated and look-through assets like Imerys (mineral extraction) and legacy Umicore (materials) are commodity price-takers with sub-hurdle multi-cycle ROIC.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Reject). Look-through portfolio of mixed listed and private assets (Imerys, Pernod Ricard, adidas, legacy Umicore) fails to generate sustainable 12%+ ROIC or reliable pricing power across the cycle. Sub-hurdle capital efficiency and sluggish NAV progression reflect structural quality deficiencies in underlying holdings.
qualitative.evidence: GBL's portfolio is anchored by industrial mineral producer Imerys (ROIC <8%) and consumer holdings facing destocking and demand headwinds. Look-through ROIC over the past 5-10 years has consistently languished below the 12% hurdle rate, leading to persistent 30%+ NAV holding discounts.
